verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a SaaS data-movement platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never documents a Fivetran-branded command-line tool. What it does show are adjacent items: the REST API, an MCP server, and Connector SDK plugins that add skills to third-party CLIs (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI). None of these is an official Fivetran CLI, so none earns credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
